0x0037958C.label: bnusAudioMixerLoop
0x0037958C.note: real body of bnusCoreUpdateThread. Sends 'STAT' (0x53544154) via sys_event_port_send then spins on sys_event_queue_receive until the reply is 'END ' (0x454E4420) -- the SPU audio worker never runs, so this inner loop NEVER exits. Source of the q=5 log flood and a permanently spinning core; no audio block is ever mixed.
